name: Treasure Hunters (Chapter 7)
about: Normal odds per chest as published by Epic Games for the Treasure Hunters mini-season (reported 2026-11-13); the same for every player, constant outside Treasure Hours. Except Gizmos, the same treasure cannot be obtained twice.
Gizmo 1 in 127 is taken from Epic's table as the maintainer read it; the press coverage found on 2026-11-13 did not list it.

Starts 2026-11-01 at 08:00 UTC (the previous season's downtime; no chests are opened between then and the launch). Weekly rewards rotate on Sundays at 9 AM America/New_York (14:00 UTC in November 2026), as the maintainer reported. The end, about 2026-12-05, is an estimate: Epic has not announced it.
Treasure Hour multipliers are reported figures and are not applied: every chest uses the normal odds.
Every chest the counter counts (normal, rare and sprite chests) is one attempt.
